component.name: Beremiz
component.summary: Develop, compile and debug IEC 61131-3 PLC programs

description.p: Beremiz is an integrated development environment for machine automation. Create PLC programs using Structured Text, Ladder Diagram, Function Block Diagram and Sequential Function Chart, compile them, and debug a local or remote PLC runtime.

This community package downloads a separate community source build from beremiz-release. It contains unmodified Beremiz sources, MatIEC, Python dependencies and a C compiler. It is independent of the official Beremiz Snap package and is not endorsed by the Beremiz project.
Projects in Documents and network PLC connections are available by default. BACnet, Xenomai and Inkscape/SVG HMI tooling are not included.
Project dialogs do not use the desktop file chooser portal. For projects in other host folders, grant their folder with the command below.
Optional access can be enabled with these commands:

ul.li: Serial and USB devices: flatpak override --user --device=all org.beremiz.Beremiz
